### ExperimentVerdict

```ts
type ExperimentVerdict = 
  | {
  kind: "too_few";
}
  | {
  kind: "no_difference";
}
  | {
  kind: "leading";
  leader: string;
};
```

Defined in: [src/convex/funnel-rules.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/funnel-rules.ts)

What the results say, for the console:
- `too_few`: some variant has fewer than 100 exposures, or the experiment has no goal;
- `no_difference`: every interval overlaps the control's;
- `leading`: the `leader`'s interval is clear of the control's.

### BACKEND\_FLAGS

```ts
const BACKEND_FLAGS: {
  pause_signups: {
     description: "New accounts are refused, invited and administrator-created ones included, before a sign-in code is sent; existing accounts sign in as before.";
     pauses: "signups";
  };
  pause_checkout: {
     description: "New checkouts, plan switches and gift purchases are refused; running plans, cancelling, the billing portal and gift claims keep working.";
     pauses: "checkout";
  };
  pause_ai: {
     description: "Metered model calls and streams are refused before any credits are reserved.";
     pauses: "ai";
  };
  maintenance: {
     description: "A banner with your message shows on every page, after an administrator's visit and before announcements.";
  };
};
```

Defined in: [src/convex/flags.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/flags.ts)

The package's own flags, which the package itself honors: three kill
switches and the maintenance banner. Each is off until an administrator
turns it on, takes no targets or rollout, and is turned on and off from
the admin console like any flag.

## Functions

### defineFlags()

```ts
function defineFlags<T>(flags): T;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/flags.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/flags.ts)

Declare the app's flags: each key with its default and what it turns on.
Returned as given, typed, so `isEnabled` and `requireFlag` take only
these keys. A key is a lower-case letter, then letters, digits and
underscores, at most 64 characters, none of the package's own, and
never starting with `pause_` or `backend_`, which the package keeps for
flags it may add.

#### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-t"></a> `T` *extends* [`FlagDefinitions`](#flagdefinitions) |

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `flags` | `T` |

#### Returns

`T`

#### Example

```ts
const definitions = defineFlags({
  newEditor: { default: false, description: 'The rewritten editor.' },
  teamInvites: { default: true, description: 'Inviting people to a workspace.', by: 'workspace' },
})
```

***

### flagBucket()

```ts
function flagBucket(key, subjectId): number;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/flags.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/flags.ts)

A subject's bucket for a flag, from 0 to [ROLLOUT\_BUCKETS](#rollout_buckets) − 1: a
32-bit FNV-1a hash of the flag's key and the subject's id, mixed by
MurmurHash3's finalizer. The same key and id give the same bucket in every
runtime, every time; another flag gives the same subject an unrelated one,
so two 10% rollouts do not pick the same 10%.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `key` | `string` |
| `subjectId` | `string` |

#### Returns

`number`

***

### setupFlags()

```ts
function setupFlags<F>(components, options): Flags<F>;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/flags.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/flags.ts)

Feature flags, evaluated inside your own queries and mutations, and the
package's kill switches. Declare the flags in code with `defineFlags`;
an administrator overrides them from the admin console (`/admin`, the
Flags tab): on or off for everyone, or, while off, on for named accounts,
named workspaces, the plans a billing entity is on, and a percentage of
accounts or workspaces picked by a stable hash. Every change takes a
recent sign-in and is recorded on the audit trail as `flag.changed`.

The package's own flags are always there: `pause_signups`,
`pause_checkout` and `pause_ai`, which the package honors where those
calls run (refused as `unavailable`, reason `<service>_paused`), and
`maintenance`, a banner with your message on every page.

#### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-f-2"></a> `F` *extends* [`FlagDefinitions`](#flagdefinitions) |

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`FlagsComponents`](#flagscomponents) |
| `options` | [`SetupFlagsOptions`](#setupflagsoptions)\<`F`\> |

#### Returns

[`Flags`](#flags-1)\<`F`\>

#### Example

```ts [backend/flags.ts]
import { defineFlags, setupFlags } from 'nuxt-backend/flags'
import { components } from './_generated/api'
import { audit } from './audit'
import { billing } from './billing'

export const flags = setupFlags(components, {
  flags: defineFlags({
    newEditor: { default: false, description: 'The rewritten editor.' },
  }),
  audit,
  billing,
})

export const { getFlags, listFlags, setFlag, exposeExperiment, getExperiments } = flags.api
```
